observation.visible_scene: A white plastic track-and-tower structure stands on a light wooden floor, holding many rows of translucent colored domino-like pieces arranged on ramps and tracks (left ramp, left vertical stack, central tracks, right-middle track, far-right curved track, and a bottom-right straight track).
visible_changes: At t=0 the right-middle track's red and dark-blue pieces are upright; from about t=0.08 they topple one after another toward that track's far end.
The toppling reaches the lower part of the far-right curved track around t=0.32-0.7, where its bottom pieces tilt and lie down while the upper arc of the curve remains standing.
The bottom-right straight track (black/red/orange) and the left ramp tracks (red/rainbow) stay upright for the whole excerpt.

From about t=1.2-1.3 the left vertical stack of rainbow pieces begins to lean leftward and then collapse; white connector pieces detach and tumble, with a white piece coming to rest on the floor near the left support by t=1.6.
The wooden-floor background and the structure's position in frame stay fixed, indicating no camera pan or zoom.
outside_clip_unknowns: What started the right-side chain reaction (it is already underway at t=0).
Whether the left collapse is causally linked to the right-side wave (no connecting path is visible within the segment).
The final state of the structure after t=1.6.
uncertain_details: Exact sequence of individual piece contacts.
Minor apparent shifts of pieces in the central tracks.
Precise frame at which the left stack first begins to move.
